newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar settles lower amid thin volume.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar settles lower amid thin volume.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures ended slightly down in rangebound and light trade, floor sources said.
Mixed activity, including trade selling and scale-down trade buying, was cited amid volume estimated at only 9,579 lots.
A dearth of fundamental news kept the tone dull as benchmark May remained between technical support at 10.85, and resistance at 10.95 to 11.00 cents.
May closed 0.04 lower at 10.88 cents per lb, having ranged from 10.93 to 10.84 cents. The back months finished 0.02 to 0.06 cent weaker.

Traders said prices could gradually work toward the top of the trading range despite the day's losses. Speculative buying in May and trade buying in the May/July spread is expected to hold the market around current levels, they said.
